A simply supported beam AB of span L=4 m carries a concentrated vertical load P=20 kN at distance a=2.67 m from support A as shown in the figure. What is the maximum bending moment developed in the beam?

A
21.5 kN·m
B
17.76 kN·m
✓ Correct
C

D
8.88 kN·m
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option B)

Support reaction at A is RA=P·bL=20×1.334=6.65 kN. Maximum bending moment occurs directly under the point load: Mmax=RA·a=6.65×2.67=17.76 kN·m.
